$comment: Schema for a recruited synthetic beta tester. Kept as persona-schema.json for backward compatibility with early docs.

id.$comment: Hyphenated slug. Unique within a run. Used in report filenames and rubric tables.

segment.example: First-time user installing and invoking the changed Claude Code command

quotaGroup.$comment: Which recruitment quota or risk surface this tester satisfies.

model.$comment: Intended model policy for this tester. Runtime may not enforce per-subagent model selection.

screeningCriteria.$comment: What qualifies this tester segment, mirroring real beta recruitment screening.
example: has not read internal design docs
does not know slash-command registration caveat

contextPolicy.$comment: How much context the tester may see initially.

allowedContext.$comment: Files or information this tester may use initially.

forbiddenInitialContext.$comment: Context the tester should not inspect unless progressive disclosure is justified.

successCondition.$comment: Observable success condition for this tester.
successCondition.example: Can complete the target flow without hidden internal knowledge

recruitedBecause.$comment: Which beta-plan risk/surface led to this tester being recruited.
recruitedBecause.example: README quickstart and command discovery changed; first-time adoption is a release risk.

example.segment: First-time user installing and invoking the changed Claude Code command
screeningCriteria: has not read internal design docs
does not know slash-command registration caveat
example.successCondition: Can discover and run /code-beta or recover from Unknown command without hidden internal knowledge
example.recruitedBecause: The harness is copied into projects and command discovery timing is a known first-run risk.
